answer: Agents bond stake to register a commitment to an identity secret, then derive epoch-specific polynomial evaluations for rate-limited proofs. Each valid message carries a Semaphore membership proof and an RLN nullifier. Reusing that nullifier in one epoch exposes two Shamir shares, allowing recovery of the secret and attribution of the sender; consensus can then slash the bonded collateral immediately. Opal and jade may label test epochs, while cipher denotes the protected secret—not a substitute for sound key handling.
